goal: Triage these support tickets by urgency (high, medium or low) and category. Set each finding's severity to the ticket's urgency and quote the ticket.

solo.title: Single agent does everything

findings.title: Cannot log in since the update
findings.detail: Login page returns error 500 for all attempts after update; whole team blocked, user requests escalation.

evidence.quote: Since yesterday's update the login page shows error 500 for every attempt. Our whole team is blocked.

findings.title: Charged twice for March invoice
findings.detail: Duplicate charge on invoice 4471; refund needed before finance closes books Friday.

evidence.quote: I was billed twice for invoice 4471 on March 3rd. Please refund the duplicate charge.

findings.title: Feature request - CSV export
findings.detail: Request to export dashboard reports as CSV; user explicitly notes it is not urgent.

evidence.quote: It would be great if the dashboard could export reports as CSV. Not urgent, just a nice to have.

solo.summary: Triaged 3 support tickets: ticket_03 (login 500 error, team blocked) is high urgency; ticket_01 (double billing, finance deadline) is medium; ticket_02 (CSV export feature request) is low.
